title: Clockwork Knight: Pepperouchau no Daibouken Joukan
native_title: クロックワーク・ナイト ～ペパルーチョの大冒険・上巻～
overview:
New, yet nostalgic. Into a toy world full of three-dimensional traps...

Every night at midnight, the voice of the clockwork doll Chelsea wakes the toys of the house. When she is carried off by a mysterious force and the lesser toys are hypnotized into fierce minions, the clumsy toy soldier Sir Pepperouchau III - Pepper for short - sets out with his rival Ginger to bring her back.

Guide Pepper through rooms full of toys and household objects in this side-scrolling platformer. Stab enemies with your wind-up key, pick up stunned foes and toys to throw, and race to the goal before time runs out while searching side areas for treasure. Each room ends with a battle against a giant polygon boss with its own weak point.

- 1 player
- Training, Normal and Hard difficulty settings

新しいけど懐かしい。三次元トラップいっぱいのおもちゃワールドへ……。
